DuckDuckGo search tool returned a connection error ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>") and a direct Google query returned HTTP 429, so domestic supply could not be checked. note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and bill-of-lading number — not merely website claims. Declared HS 340249 does not match the observed shipment HS codes: exports are dyestuffs/pigments under HS 32041680, 32041982 and 32041761, and the import is HS 29182990. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company is retained and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 3204-series (synthetic organic dyestuffs / food colours), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader (exports own-branded dyestuffs to UAE/Indonesia/Malaysia while importing Bon Acid from China and goods from BASF Hong Kong). Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is only partly supported: one export line is food colours (Tartrazine), the bulk is industrial pigment/reactive dyes. Domestic supply side remains unverified — no traces of domestic deliveries found in the sources reachable, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed; this is a gap in evidence, not a negative finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free views consulted.
